name: Cama de plataforma con respaldo
adaptations: Original is pine plywood with oil-wax finish; written as T18 with danish-oil, the closest finish id
Size estimated: 2 plazas read as matrimonial 1350 x 1900; the seller gives no measures
Platform is five loose slotted boards over a frame with a central spine; the module builds its own platform
Headboard is a flat rounded board standing on two posts above the platform; written as a plain headboard 700 mm from the floor
legs of an estimated 100 mm (the least the module allows) under the frame
notes: Cama matrimonial baja de triplay: plataforma de tablones sobre un bastidor de canto con patas cónicas en las esquinas, y un respaldo liso sobre dos postes. Sin cajones.
